name: Teralov
description: Teralov was a planet where the rebellion attempted to take supplies in 2 BBY. However en route, the rebel ships were attacked by Imperial forces led by Captain Vult Skerris, a brief battle occurred resulting in the destruction of all the rebel ships and failure to deliver the supplies.
lead_paragraphs: Teralov was a planet where the rebellion attempted to take supplies in 2 BBY. However en route, the rebel ships were attacked by Imperial forces led by Captain Vult Skerris, a brief battle occurred resulting in the destruction of all the rebel ships and failure to deliver the supplies.
